sources.title: fbjr/qwen3-vl-32b-W4A16-AWQ-H3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The full 64-layer Qwen3-VL 32B encoder from MiniMax H3, compressed as symmetric group-128 W4A16 AWQ and calibrated on H3 text, keyframe, and multimodal-reference prompts.

sources.title: GitHub - ethanfel/ComfyUI-qwen3-vl-32b-W4A16-AWQ-H3: ComfyUI loader for ...
sources.snippet: This custom node loads the fbjr/qwen3-vl-32b-W4A16-AWQ-H3 compressed-tensors checkpoint as the Qwen3-VL encoder used by MiniMax H3 workflows. The node keeps ComfyUI's native H3 architecture, tokenizer, conditioning, offload, and model patching.

sources.title: AIAny - Qwen3-VL-32B Ultra Uncensored Heretic — MiniMax-H3 ComfyUI INT8 ...
sources.snippet: Provides ComfyUI-ready INT8 MiniMax‑H3 checkpoints (conditioning encoder plus optional generation tail) for a Heretic-edited Qwen3‑VL‑32B source; preserves the vision tower in BF16 and uses row-wise ConvRot INT8 quantization to reduce VRAM needs for ~32GB GPUs. Not a full Transformers generation repository.

sources.title: Qwen - Models in Amazon Bedrock - AWS
sources.snippet: Introducing Qwen models in Amazon Bedrock Qwen3's advanced open weight foundation models are now available in Amazon Bedrock as a fully managed, serverless offering, empowering you to build sophisticated AI applications with agentic capabilities and advanced reasoning.
